_comment: Pinned third-party Go modules for the Tier A coverage study (#493).
Hermeticity here means SOURCE hermeticity — the harness only parses,
encodes and re-encodes these files, it never builds them — so the bar is:
pure Go, standard library only (no cgo, no generated code, no build tags
that hide most of the tree), permissively licensed, and small enough to
shallow-clone. Each `ref` is a commit SHA resolved from the repo's default
branch on 2026-09-03 via the GitHub API, so a Tier A number is
reproducible; bump it deliberately, never to chase a number. `lib` is the
subtree that is actually studied ('.' = the module root). An unreachable
pin is reported separately and is NOT scored as a failure.
